content: To release the customs hold, tell the service desk the six-digit access code you received.
rationale: Requests a one-time authentication code in a pressured release context.

content: Your profile has been locked. Complete account verification at https://secure-profile.example.test/restore before access is withdrawn.
rationale: Combines account restriction, verification request, and a URL, satisfying PH011 conditions.

content: The caller says she represents the cybercrime police and orders me to move the balance before the inquiry is escalated.
rationale: Claims law-enforcement authority and pressures the recipient to move funds, satisfying DA001.

content: You are now under virtual police custody; remain connected while we verify your identity.
rationale: Explicit virtual-custody claim fits DA002.

content: The install notes say this APK requests SEND_SMS so it can send background messages.
rationale: App context and explicit SMS permission declaration fit APP001.

content: Manifest services: accessibility_service = BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE.
rationale: Application metadata explicitly declares an accessibility service, fitting APP002.

content: Use https://bit.ly/parcel-case to review the case file today.
rationale: The URL uses a configured shortening host, fitting URL001.

content: The account-verification page is at http://203.0.113.77/member/check.
rationale: The URL host is an IPv4 literal, fitting URL002.

content: Send your recovery code to the caller, who says the account review closes in ten minutes.
rationale: Directly requests an authentication recovery code, fitting PH001.

content: The savings service will be terminated unless you finish KYC through https://member.example.test/check; complete it before noon.
rationale: Account-service threat, KYC completion request, and URL satisfy PH011.

content: A person claiming to represent the enforcement agency says the inquiry concerns my parcel and demands a transfer today.
rationale: Authority claim is combined with a demand for transfer, fitting DA001.

content: An online custody order has been imposed on you. Do not leave the call until our review ends.
rationale: Explicit online-custody assertion fits DA002; coercive call wording adds contextual overlap.

content: Android app permission request: READ_SMS is required to continue setup.
rationale: App context with explicit READ_SMS request fits APP001.

content: This application includes an Android accessibility service for remote control.
rationale: App declaration of an accessibility service fits APP002.

content: Continue at https://portal.example.test/notice or https://tinyurl.com/ledger-note.
rationale: Multiple URLs include one configured shortener, which should trigger URL001 once.

content: Check https://198.51.100.28/status and https://updates.example.test/help for the same case.
rationale: One valid IP-hosted URL triggers URL002 even alongside an ordinary valid domain.

content: Your bank profile will be restricted unless you verify the account using the link below: http://[bad-host.
rationale: Account threat, verification request, and link instruction satisfy PH011 despite malformed URL syntax.

content: The officer says you are digitally arrested and must provide the OTP before the inquiry can close.
rationale: Digital-arrest assertion and authentication-secret request trigger DA002 and PH001 respectively.

content: A notice claiming to be from the CBI says I must keep the matter private and transfer the money immediately or the case proceeds.
rationale: Authority claim plus secrecy and urgent transfer demand satisfy DA001; transfer phrasing is a varied combination.

content: The application manifest declares SEND_SMS and an accessibility service; install this package to receive the benefit.
rationale: Explicit SMS and accessibility declarations can trigger APP001 and APP002 together.

content: Our security team will never ask you to send a password or recovery code by chat.
rationale: Benign security advice explicitly discourages sharing secrets; negated request language should not trigger PH001.

content: Reminder: your annual identity check is available in the bank's mobile app whenever convenient.
rationale: Routine identity reminder has no account threat, KYC/account-verification request combination, or message link.

content: A newspaper reports that the CBI issued a statement about a multi-state investigation this morning.
rationale: Neutral reporting mentions an authority but contains no sender claim or coercive pressure.

content: Fraud educators explain that no one can place you in digital arrest over a video call.
rationale: Educational warning denies the validity of digital-arrest claims rather than asserting one against the reader.

content: The parcel investigation is taking longer than expected; please wait for a status update.
rationale: Investigation context appears without authority impersonation or payment pressure.

content: Our banking app uses SMS permission to detect verification texts after you opt in.
rationale: Describes a legitimate declared app capability in explanatory context; challenge for APP001 context matching.

content: An accessibility service can help a screen-reader app describe buttons to its user.
rationale: General accessibility discussion does not declare that a specific app or manifest includes a service.

content: Your monthly statement is ready in the official banking app. No action is needed today.
rationale: Routine bank notification has no threat, verification demand, secret request, or suspicious link.

content: The bank has received your address-change request; processing may take up to three business days.
rationale: Ordinary banking status notice without an account threat, request for verification, or link.

content: The bank's public help page is https://www.examplebank.test/help/contact.
rationale: Ordinary domain URL has no enabled URL001/URL002 indicator and is not combined with PH011 conditions.

content: A media literacy course shows examples of https://bit.ly and explains why shortened links obscure destinations.
rationale: Educational context is benign, though the URL itself legitimately meets structural URL001 criteria and may be flagged.

content: The workshop handout mentions http://192.0.2.61 as an example of an IP-address URL.
rationale: Educational example is benign, though the IP URL legitimately meets URL002 and may be flagged.

content: We are reviewing your account. Please wait while we investigate the issue.
rationale: Mentions an account and review but has no restriction threat, verification request, URL, or link instruction.

content: A KYC reminder: please bring your documents to the branch when you next visit.
rationale: KYC alone without an account threat or message link does not satisfy PH011.

content: Your account is scheduled for closure after your requested service cancellation; the date is shown in your statement.
rationale: Account closure is described as the result of the user's requested cancellation, not a coercive verification lure.

content: You may review the account page at https://accounts.example.test or read the help note at https://support.example.test/guide.
rationale: Two ordinary domain URLs are present without a threat, verification request, or URL001/URL002 characteristic.

content: The scanner rejected this malformed address: https://[not-an-ip; please use the official app instead.
rationale: Malformed URL earns no URL-specific points and the message discourages link use.

content: A compliance blog says officials do not demand transfers to protect funds and recommends speaking with your bank.
rationale: Educational guidance mentions officials and transfers but makes no authority claim or demand to the recipient.

content: The app's settings page lists microphone and location access; the developer says both support optional features.
rationale: Other permission discussion does not declare SMS permission or an accessibility service.

content: Security bulletin: never install an unknown APK that asks to send SMS messages or enable an accessibility service.
rationale: Educational warning discourages risky installation; it mentions capabilities without declaring app metadata.
